---
metadata-files:
  - _paper.yml
  - _authors.yml
date: today
bibliography: references.bib
format:
  # ── PDF (working paper style) ──────────────────────────────
  # Requires the hikmah extension (included in _extensions/)
  # Render: quarto render working-paper.qmd --to hikmah-pdf
  hikmah-pdf:
    toc: false
    number-sections: true
    keep-tex: true
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        \usepackage{threeparttable}
        \usepackage{threeparttablex}
        \usepackage{longtable}
        \usepackage{booktabs}
  # ── HTML (self-contained) ──────────────────────────────────
  # Render: quarto render working-paper.qmd --to html
  html:
    toc: true
    number-sections: true
    self-contained: true
  # ── Word (docx) ───────────────────────────────────────────
  # Render: quarto render working-paper.qmd --to docx
  docx:
    toc: true
    number-sections: true
knitr:
  opts_chunk:
    echo: false
    message: false
    warning: false
---

{{< include _content.qmd >}}
